methods.label: Price action
methods.definition: Structure, levels, candles and liquidity; no indicator required.

methods.label: Indicator
methods.definition: Moving averages, oscillators, bands, channels and volatility measures.

methods.label: Volume and order flow
methods.definition: Relative volume, delivery %, open interest, implied volatility and participant data.

methods.label: Fundamental and ownership
methods.definition: Financial statements, ratios, shareholding and disclosures.

methods.label: Legends
methods.definition: Screens named after published methods of well-known traders and investors.

methods.label: My screens
methods.definition: Screens you or your team built. Pre-built screens are never filed here.

setups.label: Breakout / breakdown
setups.definition: Price leaving a range, level or base.

setups.label: Pullback / continuation
setups.definition: A trend, a correction against it and a trigger back in its direction.

setups.label: Reversal
setups.definition: Exhaustion, divergence, a failed break or a sweep at a level.

setups.label: Range / mean reversion
setups.definition: Range edges, bands and squeezes before a move.

setups.label: Momentum / relative strength
setups.definition: Strength against the market or a sector, and leadership.

setups.label: Options and volatility
setups.definition: Futures and options buildups, IV rank, PCR, premium decay and spreads.

setups.label: Events and flow
setups.definition: Results, ex-dates, disclosures, bulk deals, FII/DII flows and gaps on news.

screens.name: Momentum
screens.definition: RSI(14) above 60 and close above EMA(close, 20) on the scan's timeframe.

screens.name: Oversold
screens.definition: RSI(14) at or below 30 on the scan's timeframe.

screens.name: Trend on the daily
screens.definition: Close above EMA(close, 50) on daily bars.

screens.name: Swing 1H range breakout
screens.definition: Close beyond the 20-bar range on 1H by an ATR buffer, on volume; only when the Daily and Weekly trends are not against the break.

screens.name: Daily swing-high / low break (BOS / CHoCH)
screens.definition: Daily close beyond the last confirmed swing high or low by an ATR buffer; context: weekly trend, not against the break.

screens.name: Intraday 15m NR7 breakout
screens.definition: The bar after the narrowest range of 7 bars closes beyond it on volume (15m); only when the 1H and Daily trends are not against it.

screens.name: Daily 52-week high breakout
screens.definition: Daily close above the prior 52-week high on volume; only when the weekly trend is not down.

screens.name: Weekly 52-week high breakout
screens.definition: Weekly close above the prior 52-week high on volume; no higher-timeframe trend filter.

screens.name: Intraday 15m ATR expansion
screens.definition: A 15m bar at least 2 ATR wide with its close in the top or bottom third, on volume; only when the 1H and Daily trends are not against it.

screens.name: Intraday 5m volume breakout
screens.definition: A 5m volume shock at or through the 20-bar high or low with a directional candle; only when the 15m and 1H trends are not against it.

screens.name: Intraday ORB: 15-minute opening range on 5m
screens.definition: First 5m close beyond the 09:15-09:30 range that passes the volume / VWAP checks; once per side a day; 15m and 1H trends not against it.

screens.name: Intraday ORB: 30-minute opening range on 15m
screens.definition: First 15m close beyond the 09:15-09:45 range that passes the volume / VWAP checks; only when the 1H and Daily trends are not against it.

screens.name: Intraday first-hour high / low break on 15m
screens.definition: First 15m close beyond the 09:15-10:15 high or low that passes the volume / VWAP checks; 1H and Daily trends not against it.

screens.name: Intraday previous-day high / low break on 5m
screens.definition: First 5m close beyond the previous session's high or low after the first 15 minutes that passes the volume / VWAP checks; 15m and 1H trends not against it.

screens.name: Intraday new high / low of day on 5m
screens.definition: 5m close beyond the session's high or low so far, with time-of-day volume and VWAP agreement; once per leg; 15m and 1H trends not against it.

screens.name: Intraday Gappers
screens.definition: The session opened away from the previous close by at least a set percent; optional pre-open volume, daily turnover and daily range checks.

screens.name: New Day High
screens.definition: A close above the session's high so far, on high volume for the time of day, the session's volume above normal and a recent range wide enough to move.

screens.name: New Day Low
screens.definition: A close below the session's low so far, on high volume for the time of day, the session's volume above normal and a recent range wide enough to move.

screens.name: Top Reversal
screens.definition: A large rise from the session's open, then a bearish reversal candle at or near the session's high.

screens.name: Bottom Reversal
screens.definition: A large fall from the session's open, then a bullish reversal candle at or near the session's low.

screens.name: VWAP Break
screens.definition: The close crosses above the session VWAP on high volume for the time of day; the mirror reads the cross below.

screens.name: Turbo Breakup
screens.definition: A new session high on 1-minute bars with unusual 1-minute volume for the time of day.

screens.name: Turbo Breakdown
screens.definition: A new session low on 1-minute bars with unusual 1-minute volume for the time of day.

screens.name: RSI Extreme
screens.definition: 5-minute RSI above a high level or below a low level, with the session's volume so far and the price inside a set range.

screens.name: Volume Surge
screens.definition: Volume against the average of the same time of day in previous sessions: this bar, or the session so far.

screens.name: Key Levels
screens.definition: The close is within a set distance of a key level: previous close, high or low, pre-open high or low, moving averages or the 52-week high or low.

note: Screens are filed by how they reason and what they look for. Filing is not a ranking and not advice.
